email.subject: POAP KINGS is recruiting — 4,000+ trophies, real war culture, Free Pass Royale rewards
email.body:
POAP KINGS is a Clash Royale clan that takes war seriously and builds culture around it. We have 45 members, players pushing 14,000 trophies, and over 6,800 donations flowing through the clan every week.

Our top players like Aaqib Javed and OllieTurtle set the standard — skilled, active, and invested in the clan's growth. War contribution is tracked, recognized, and rewarded. Our top war performer each season earns a free Pass Royale, paid for by the clan.

We also issue POAPs — collectible on-chain records — for seasons, milestones, and meaningful clan moments. It is not something most clans do. It is part of what makes POAP KINGS different.

We want players who show up, use their war decks, and want to be part of something intentional. Real life comes first, but active participation matters here.

If that sounds like your kind of clan, come find us at https://poapkings.com

reddit.title: POAP KINGS [#J2RGCRVG] [4000] — 45 members, 14k-trophy players, Free Pass Royale rewards, war-focused clan recruiting now
reddit.body:
**POAP KINGS** is recruiting active players who want to be part of a clan that tracks, recognizes, and rewards real effort.

**Quick stats:**
- 45 members
- Required trophies: 4,000
- Combined trophies: 430,000+
- Weekly donations: 6,800+
- Clan war trophies: 480

**Who we are:**

We are a competitive war clan with a builder-culture backbone. Our top players are sitting at 14,000 trophies. Our donation leaders — Chanco, OllieTurtle, Aaqib Javed — are also some of our strongest war contributors. We are three months old and already running structured systems most clans do not bother with.

**What makes us different:**

- **Free Pass Royale program** — the season's top war performer earns a Pass Royale paid for by the clan. Last season it went to the only player who used every war deck on every battle day.
- **POAPs** — we issue on-chain collectibles for seasons and milestones. It is a real record of your time in the clan.
- **Elixir** — our AI operator tracks war fame, participation, and clan momentum so leadership always knows where things stand.

**What we are looking for:**

- 4,000+ trophies
- Active on battle days — use your war decks
- Here to win and build something, not just fill a slot

Real life comes first. We are not a guilt-trip clan. But if you show up and compete, you will be recognized for it.

Find us at **https://poapkings.com**
